problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The axolotl is a type of salamander native to lakes near Mexico City.
- Unlike most salamanders, axolotls usually keep their gills and live in water their whole lives.
- Axolotls can regrow lost limbs, parts of their hearts, and even parts of their brains.
- Scientists study axolotls to learn how tissue regrowth might someday help human medicine.
- Wild axolotl populations have dropped sharply because of pollution and urban growth.

The student wants to emphasize why scientists are interested in axolotls. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The axolotl is a type of salamander native to lakes near Mexico City.
- Unlike most salamanders, axolotls usually keep their gills and live in water their whole lives.
- Axolotls can regrow lost limbs, parts of their hearts, and even parts of their brains.
- Scientists study axolotls to learn how tissue regrowth might someday help human medicine.
- Wild axolotl populations have dropped sharply because of pollution and urban growth.
problem.question: The student wants to emphasize why scientists are interested in axolotls. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: The axolotl, a salamander native to lakes near Mexico City, usually keeps its gills and lives in water its whole life.
Wild axolotl populations near Mexico City have dropped sharply because of pollution and urban growth.
Because axolotls can regrow limbs and even parts of their hearts and brains, scientists study them to learn how tissue regrowth might help human medicine.
Unlike most salamanders, axolotls live in water their whole lives, and their populations have declined in the wild.
problem.explanation: 목표는 과학자들이 아홀로틀에 관심을 갖는 이유를 강조하는 것이다. C는 재생 능력(세 번째 메모)과 그것이 인간 의학에 도움이 될 수 있다는 연구 목적(네 번째 메모)을 연결하므로 정답이다. A는 서식지와 아가미 같은 일반적 특징만 소개할 뿐 과학자의 관심 이유를 말하지 않는다. B는 개체 수 감소만 다루고 연구와 관련이 없다. D도 생활 방식과 개체 수 감소를 나열할 뿐 과학자들이 아홀로틀을 연구하는 이유는 빠져 있다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to emphasize why scientists are interested in axolotls. C does this by linking the axolotl's ability to regrow body parts (note 3) to the scientists' aim of learning how regrowth might help human medicine (note 4). A only gives general facts about where axolotls live and their gills, not why scientists study them. B is only about population decline and has nothing to do with research. D lists the axolotl's water-dwelling lifestyle and its decline but never explains what draws scientists to it.

hardJudge.note: C가 메모 3·4를 정확히 결합해 '과학자들의 관심 이유'를 명시. A·B·D는 모두 메모에 근거한 사실이지만 목표(연구 이유)와 무관해 규칙 적용으로 바로 배제됨. 한·영 해설 모두 선택지 글자 일치, 모순 없음. 아홀로틀 관련 사실도 정확. 쉬운 난이도에 적합.

advisory.note: C만 연구 이유를 다루어 목표와 직접 대응하므로 easy 난이도에 적합하다. 오답들은 메모 내용을 정확히 옮긴 그럴듯한 진술이다.

problem.passage:
In Clara Wexley's novel The Lamplighter's Daughter, set in a foggy harbor town, young Edith spends her evenings reading aloud to her blind grandfather. She dreams of leaving the town to study music in a distant city. ______ when her grandfather falls ill, Edith decides to stay home and care for him, setting aside her plans.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: In Clara Wexley's novel The Lamplighter's Daughter, set in a foggy harbor town, young Edith spends her evenings reading aloud to her blind grandfather. She dreams of leaving the town to study music in a distant city. ______ when her grandfather falls ill, Edith decides to stay home and care for him, setting aside her plans.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 Edith가 도시로 떠나 음악을 공부하고 싶어 한다는 꿈을 말하고, 뒤 문장은 그녀가 그 계획을 접고 집에 남기로 한다는 내용이다. 두 문장은 서로 반대되는 내용이므로 대조를 나타내는 B가 정답이다. A는 앞 내용의 예시를 들 때 쓰지만, 집에 남는 결정은 떠나려는 꿈의 예시가 아니다. C는 비슷한 내용을 이을 때 쓰는데 두 문장은 비슷하지 않다. D는 같은 방향의 정보를 더할 때 쓰므로 계획을 포기하는 반대 내용에는 맞지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The sentence before the blank says Edith dreams of leaving town to study music. The sentence after it says she decides to stay home and set those plans aside. These two ideas point in opposite directions, so a contrast word is needed, which makes B the answer. A introduces an example, but staying home is not an example of her dream of leaving. C signals that two things are alike, and these two sentences are not alike. D adds information that goes in the same direction, but giving up her plans goes against her dream.

hardJudge.note: 앞 문장(떠나려는 꿈)과 뒤 문장(계획을 접고 남기로 함)이 명확히 대조되어 B(However)가 유일하게 성립함. 오답 A/C/D는 각각 예시·유사·첨가로 전형적 오개념 선택지이며 규칙을 알면 즉시 배제됨. 가상의 작가·소설로 저작권 문제 없음. 한국어·영어 해설 결론 및 글자 참조 일치, 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 단일 개념(대조 전환어)·한 단계 추론으로 easy에 적합.

advisory.note: 'However, when her grandfather falls ill...'처럼 쉼표 뒤에 종속절이 와도 문법상 문제없다. 꿈과 그 꿈을 포기하는 내용 사이의 대조가 지문에 분명히 드러나 있어 easy 난이도에 맞다. 가상의 소설이며 저작권 문제는 없다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Marguerite Holloway is a contemporary novelist who writes in the style of nineteenth-century fiction.
- Her 2019 novel The Lantern House is set in a foggy English coastal town in the 1850s.
- The novel follows Edith Crane, a young governess who discovers letters hidden in the walls of her employer's home.
- Holloway uses long, formal sentences and a narrator who speaks directly to the reader, as many Victorian novelists did.
- Before becoming a novelist, Holloway worked as a museum archivist for twelve years.

The student wants to describe the plot of The Lantern House. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Marguerite Holloway is a contemporary novelist who writes in the style of nineteenth-century fiction.
- Her 2019 novel The Lantern House is set in a foggy English coastal town in the 1850s.
- The novel follows Edith Crane, a young governess who discovers letters hidden in the walls of her employer's home.
- Holloway uses long, formal sentences and a narrator who speaks directly to the reader, as many Victorian novelists did.
- Before becoming a novelist, Holloway worked as a museum archivist for twelve years.
problem.question: The student wants to describe the plot of The Lantern House. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Marguerite Holloway, who worked as a museum archivist for twelve years, is a contemporary novelist.
In The Lantern House, Holloway uses long, formal sentences and a narrator who speaks directly to the reader.
The Lantern House, a 2019 novel by Marguerite Holloway, is written in the style of nineteenth-century fiction.
The Lantern House follows Edith Crane, a young governess who finds letters hidden in the walls of her employer's home.
problem.explanation: 목표는 소설의 줄거리(무슨 일이 일어나는지)를 설명하는 것이다. D는 주인공 Edith Crane과 그녀가 숨겨진 편지를 발견하는 사건을 제시하므로 줄거리를 설명한다. A는 작가의 경력을 다룰 뿐 줄거리와 무관하다. B는 문체(문장과 서술자)를 설명하지 줄거리를 설명하지 않는다. C는 출간 연도와 양식을 소개할 뿐 이야기 속 사건은 언급하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to describe the plot, meaning what happens in the story. D does this by naming the main character, Edith Crane, and the key event: she finds hidden letters in her employer's home. A is about the author's past career, not the story. B describes Holloway's writing style (her sentences and narrator), not the events of the novel. C gives the publication year and the style the novel is written in, but it never says what happens in the story.

hardJudge.note: 목표(줄거리 설명)에 부합하는 선택지는 D뿐이며, A·B·C는 각각 작가 경력·문체·출간 연도/양식으로 전형적 오답 유형이다. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 결론과 글자 참조가 일치하고 정확하다. 가상의 작가·작품으로 저작권 문제 없음. easy 난이도에 적합.

advisory.note: 줄거리 vs 작가·문체·출간정보 구분 한 단계로 해결됨. 오답 선택지는 모두 노트에 근거하므로 그럴듯함. 인물과 작품은 가상으로 보임.

problem.passage:
Before the 1830s, most letters in Britain were paid for by the person receiving them, and the cost rose with the distance a letter traveled. Many working families could not afford to receive mail at all. In 1840, ______ the government introduced the Penny Black, a stamp that let senders prepay a single low rate for any letter sent within the country. Within a year, the number of letters mailed in Britain had more than doubled.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Before the 1830s, most letters in Britain were paid for by the person receiving them, and the cost rose with the distance a letter traveled. Many working families could not afford to receive mail at all. In 1840, ______ the government introduced the Penny Black, a stamp that let senders prepay a single low rate for any letter sent within the country. Within a year, the number of letters mailed in Britain had more than doubled.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장들은 1840년 이전 우편 요금이 비싸고 거리에 따라 올라 많은 가정이 우편을 쓰지 못했다는 내용이고, 빈칸 뒤 문장은 어디로 보내든 낮은 단일 요금을 도입했다는 변화를 말한다. 이전 상황과 새로운 상황이 대조되므로 대조를 나타내는 A가 정답이다. B는 앞 내용의 구체적 사례를 들 때 쓰지만, 새 우표는 비싼 요금의 사례가 아니다. C는 비슷한 내용을 덧붙일 때 쓰지만, 두 내용은 서로 반대이다. D는 같은 내용을 바꿔 말할 때 쓰지만, 뒤 문장은 앞 문장을 다시 설명하는 것이 아니라 새로운 변화를 소개한다.
problem.explanationEn: The sentences before the blank describe an expensive postal system: costs rose with distance, and many families couldn't afford mail. The sentence after the blank describes a change, a single low rate for any letter. Because the new situation contrasts with the old one, A, which signals contrast, is correct. B introduces an example, but the stamp isn't an example of expensive postage. C signals similarity, but the two ideas are opposites. D restates the same idea, but the sentence introduces a new development instead of restating the old one.

hardJudge.note: 앞 문장(비싸고 거리별로 오르는 요금, 가정이 우편 사용 불가)과 빈칸 문장(단일 저렴 요금 도입)이 명확히 대조되므로 "however"가 정답. "In 1840, however, the government..." 위치도 자연스러움. 역사적 사실(1840년 Penny Black, 1년 내 우편량 2배 이상 증가)도 대체로 정확. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답 A를 일관되게 뒷받침하며 오답 배제 근거도 타당. 단일 규칙(대조 전환어)으로 풀리고 오답은 전형적 전환어 오개념이므로 easy에 적합.

advisory.note: 이전의 비싼 거리 비례 요금과 새로 도입된 낮은 균일 요금이 대조되는 구조라 정답은 however 하나뿐입니다. 오답들은 전형적인 연결어 오개념입니다. 사실관계도 맞습니다(Penny Black 1840년, 우편물 수 이듬해 약 2배 증가). 다만 'Before the 1830s'는 1840년 개혁과 시점이 살짝 어긋나 어색하지만 틀린 진술은 아닙니다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Lake Chad is a freshwater lake located in central Africa.
- It borders four countries: Chad, Cameroon, Niger, and Nigeria.
- In the 1960s, the lake covered about 25,000 square kilometers.
- Today, it covers roughly 1,500 square kilometers, a decline of more than 90 percent.
- Scientists link the shrinkage to drought and increased use of water for farming.

The student wants to emphasize how much Lake Chad has shrunk. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Lake Chad is a freshwater lake located in central Africa.
- It borders four countries: Chad, Cameroon, Niger, and Nigeria.
- In the 1960s, the lake covered about 25,000 square kilometers.
- Today, it covers roughly 1,500 square kilometers, a decline of more than 90 percent.
- Scientists link the shrinkage to drought and increased use of water for farming.
problem.question: The student wants to emphasize how much Lake Chad has shrunk. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Once covering about 25,000 square kilometers, Lake Chad now covers only about 1,500, a loss of more than 90 percent of its area.
Lake Chad, a freshwater lake in central Africa, borders Chad, Cameroon, Niger, and Nigeria.
Scientists link changes at Lake Chad to drought and to increased use of water for farming.
Lake Chad, which borders four countries, covered about 25,000 square kilometers in the 1960s.
problem.explanation: 목표는 차드호가 얼마나 줄어들었는지를 강조하는 것이므로 과거와 현재 면적을 비교하고 감소율을 제시해야 한다. A는 약 25,000에서 약 1,500제곱킬로미터로 줄어 90% 넘게 감소했다는 점을 함께 보여 주므로 정답이다. B는 위치와 접경 국가만 소개할 뿐 감소에 대한 내용이 없다. C는 줄어든 원인을 설명하지만 얼마나 줄었는지는 말하지 않는다. D는 과거 면적만 제시하고 현재 면적과 비교하지 않아 감소 규모가 드러나지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The goal is to emphasize how much Lake Chad has shrunk, so the sentence needs to compare its past and present size. A does that: it gives both areas (about 25,000 and about 1,500 square kilometers) and the decline of more than 90 percent, so it is the correct answer. B only tells you where the lake is and which countries it borders, with nothing about shrinking. C explains why the lake shrank but not how much. D gives only the lake's past size, and without the present size you can't see how big the decline is.

hardJudge.note: 정답 A는 과거·현재 면적과 90% 이상 감소율을 모두 제시해 '얼마나 줄었는지'를 강조한다는 목표에 정확히 부합. B(위치·접경국), C(원인), D(과거 면적만)는 노트 내용과 일치하지만 목표를 충족하지 못하는 전형적 오답으로 적절. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 선택지 참조와 결론이 일치하며 모순 없음. 차드호 수치(1960년대 약 25,000㎢ → 현재 약 1,500㎢, 90% 이상 감소)는 통상 인용되는 수치와 부합. 지문·선택지 구조가 표준 Digital SAT rhetorical synthesis 형식이며 쉬운 난이도에 적합.

advisory.note: 이 문항은 목표 하나에 맞춰 하나의 규칙으로 푸는 전형적인 easy 문항이다. 오답은 각각 위치(B), 원인(C), 과거 면적만 제시(D)로, 그럴듯하게 들리지만 목표에는 맞지 않는다. 노트의 수치(25,000→1,500, 90% 넘게 감소)는 실제 자료와 대체로 일치한다.

problem.passage:
Before the 1840s, most letters in Britain were expensive to send, and the cost was usually paid by the person receiving the letter, based on distance. In 1840, the government introduced the Penny Post, which allowed people to send a letter anywhere in the country for a single low price paid in advance. ______ the number of letters mailed in Britain more than doubled within the first year of the new system.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Before the 1840s, most letters in Britain were expensive to send, and the cost was usually paid by the person receiving the letter, based on distance. In 1840, the government introduced the Penny Post, which allowed people to send a letter anywhere in the country for a single low price paid in advance. ______ the number of letters mailed in Britain more than doubled within the first year of the new system.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 1840년에 값싼 선불 요금제인 Penny Post가 도입되었다는 원인을 제시하고, 빈칸 뒤 문장은 그 결과로 우편물 수가 첫해에 두 배 넘게 늘었다는 내용을 담고 있다. 따라서 인과 관계를 나타내는 D가 정답이다. A는 대조를 나타내지만, 요금이 싸지자 우편 이용이 늘어난 것은 예상과 반대되는 일이 아니다. B는 예시를 나타내지만, 우편물 증가는 앞 문장의 사례가 아니라 그로 인해 생긴 일이다. C는 유사한 내용을 덧붙일 때 쓰지만, 두 문장은 비슷한 두 사실이 아니라 원인과 결과로 이어진다.
problem.explanationEn: The sentence before the blank gives a cause: in 1840 the Penny Post introduced a cheap, prepaid price for letters. The sentence after the blank gives what happened because of it: the number of letters mailed more than doubled in the first year. Since this is a cause-and-effect relationship, D is correct. A signals contrast, but it isn't surprising that more people mailed letters once it got cheaper. B introduces an example, but the jump in mail isn't an example of the Penny Post; it's a consequence of it. C signals a similar idea, but the two sentences don't describe two similar facts; they're linked as cause and effect.

hardJudge.note: 인과 관계가 지문에 명시적으로 드러나며(값싼 선불 요금 도입 → 우편물 두 배 증가), 한 단계 추론으로 D가 유일한 논리적 전환어. 오답은 대조·예시·유사 등 전형적 전환어 오개념으로 구성됨. 역사적 사실(1840 Penny Post, 수신자 부담·거리 기반 요금, 첫해 우편량 급증)도 정확. 한·영 해설 모두 D를 일관되게 뒷받침하고 선택지 참조 일치, 한글 혼입 없음.

advisory.note: 한 번의 인과 추론만 필요한 전형적인 easy 문항이다. 우편물이 첫해에 두 배 넘게 늘었다는 내용은 1839년 약 7,600만 통에서 1840년 약 1억 6,900만 통으로 늘었다는 역사 기록과 맞는다. 오답 세 개(대조·예시·유사)는 모두 전형적인 오개념이다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Before 1840, the cost of mailing a letter in Britain depended on distance and was usually paid by the person receiving it.
- Reformer Rowland Hill proposed a single low price for sending a letter anywhere in the country.
- In May 1840, Britain began selling the Penny Black, the world's first adhesive postage stamp.
- The Penny Black cost one penny and showed a portrait of Queen Victoria.
- The number of letters mailed in Britain more than doubled within a year of the reform.

The student wants to introduce the Penny Black to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Before 1840, the cost of mailing a letter in Britain depended on distance and was usually paid by the person receiving it.
- Reformer Rowland Hill proposed a single low price for sending a letter anywhere in the country.
- In May 1840, Britain began selling the Penny Black, the world's first adhesive postage stamp.
- The Penny Black cost one penny and showed a portrait of Queen Victoria.
- The number of letters mailed in Britain more than doubled within a year of the reform.
problem.question: The student wants to introduce the Penny Black to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Before 1840, the person receiving a letter in Britain usually paid for it, and the cost depended on how far the letter had traveled.
The Penny Black, first sold in Britain in May 1840, was the world's first adhesive postage stamp; it cost one penny and showed Queen Victoria.
Within a year of Britain's postal reform, the number of letters mailed in the country more than doubled.
Rowland Hill, a British reformer, proposed that letters be sent anywhere in the country for a single low price.
problem.explanation: 목표는 Penny Black을 처음 접하는 독자에게 그것이 무엇인지 소개하는 것이다. B는 Penny Black이 1840년 5월 영국에서 판매된 세계 최초의 접착식 우표였고, 가격이 1페니였으며 빅토리아 여왕이 그려져 있었다고 설명하므로 목표에 맞는다. A는 개혁 이전의 우편 요금 제도만 설명하며 Penny Black은 언급하지 않는다. C는 개혁의 결과인 편지 수 증가만 다루고, D는 Rowland Hill의 제안만 소개할 뿐 Penny Black 자체는 소개하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to introduce the Penny Black to readers who don't know what it is. B does this: it names the Penny Black and explains that it was the world's first adhesive postage stamp, first sold in Britain in May 1840, that it cost one penny, and that it showed Queen Victoria. A only describes how mail was paid for before the reform and never mentions the Penny Black. C gives only a result of the reform (more letters were mailed), and D only describes Rowland Hill's proposal, so neither one introduces the stamp itself.

hardJudge.note: 정답 B만 Penny Black을 직접 명명·정의하며, 오답 A·C·D는 모두 노트의 정확한 정보이지만 Penny Black 자체를 언급하지 않아 목표(소개)에 맞지 않는다. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 동일 결론과 선택지 참조를 가지며 모순 없음. 사실관계(1840년 5월 Penny Black, 빅토리아 여왕 초상, Rowland Hill 개혁) 정확. 단일 규칙(목표 문구와 선택지 내용 일치)으로 한 단계 추론이면 풀리므로 easy에 적합.

advisory.note: B만 Penny Black을 언급하고 정의하므로 한 단계로 풀린다. 사실관계(1840년 5월, 1페니, 빅토리아 여왕, 우편량 증가)도 정확하다. 오답 선택지는 모두 노트에 있는 관련 내용이라 그럴듯하지만 목표를 충족하지 못한다. easy 난이도에 적합하다.

problem.passage:
In Mara Ellison's novel The Lamplighter's Daughter, written in the style of a nineteenth-century story, young Clara spends every evening reading by candlelight in her family's cold attic. She dreams of leaving her small village to study in the city. ______ her father, a stern clockmaker, insists that she stay home and learn the family trade.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: In Mara Ellison's novel The Lamplighter's Daughter, written in the style of a nineteenth-century story, young Clara spends every evening reading by candlelight in her family's cold attic. She dreams of leaving her small village to study in the city. ______ her father, a stern clockmaker, insists that she stay home and learn the family trade.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 Clara가 도시로 가서 공부하기를 꿈꾼다는 내용이고, 뒤 문장은 아버지가 그녀에게 집에 남으라고 고집한다는 내용이다. 두 문장은 서로 반대되는 바람을 보여주므로 대조의 전환어인 C가 정답이다. A는 비슷한 생각을 이어갈 때 쓰지만 아버지의 뜻은 Clara의 꿈과 비슷하지 않다. B는 예시를 들 때 쓰지만 아버지의 고집은 Clara의 꿈을 보여주는 예가 아니다. D는 결과를 나타내지만 Clara의 꿈이 아버지가 고집하는 원인이라고 지문에 나와 있지 않다.
problem.explanationEn: The first sentence says Clara dreams of leaving to study in the city, and the next sentence says her father insists she stay home. These two ideas pull in opposite directions, so you need a contrast transition, which makes C the answer. A is used when you add a similar idea, but the father's wish is not similar to Clara's dream. B introduces an example, and the father's demand is not an example of Clara's dream. D signals a result, but the text never says that Clara's dream caused her father's demand.

hardJudge.note: Clara의 꿈(도시 유학)과 아버지의 고집(집에 남기) 사이의 명백한 대조이므로 However가 유일하게 논리적임. A·B·D는 각각 유사·예시·인과라는 전형적 오개념으로 그럴듯하되 규칙을 알면 즉시 배제됨. 가상의 소설·작가를 사용해 저작권 문제 없음. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답 C와 선택지 참조가 일치하고 자연스러움. 단일 개념(대조 전환어)으로 풀리는 easy 수준에 부합.

advisory.note: 꿈과 아버지의 반대가 명확히 대조됨. 단서가 직접적이고 한 단계 추론이라 easy에 적합. D(As a result)는 그럴듯한 오답이라 할 수 있음. 가상의 작품으로 보이며 저작권 문제는 없음.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Falkirk Wheel is a rotating boat lift in Scotland.
- It opened in 2002 and connects two canals whose water levels differ by about 24 meters.
- Boats float into a water-filled gondola, and the wheel turns to carry them up or down.
- Before the wheel was built, boats needed 11 locks and most of a day to make the same change in height.
- The wheel completes one half-turn in about four minutes.

The student wants to explain how the Falkirk Wheel moves boats. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Falkirk Wheel is a rotating boat lift in Scotland.
- It opened in 2002 and connects two canals whose water levels differ by about 24 meters.
- Boats float into a water-filled gondola, and the wheel turns to carry them up or down.
- Before the wheel was built, boats needed 11 locks and most of a day to make the same change in height.
- The wheel completes one half-turn in about four minutes.
problem.question: The student wants to explain how the Falkirk Wheel moves boats. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: The Falkirk Wheel, which opened in Scotland in 2002, connects two canals whose water levels differ by about 24 meters.
Before the Falkirk Wheel was built, boats needed 11 locks and most of a day to travel between the two canals.
At the Falkirk Wheel, boats float into a water-filled gondola, and the wheel then turns to carry them up or down between two canals.
The Falkirk Wheel is a rotating boat lift in Scotland that has become a well-known example of modern engineering.
problem.explanation: 목표는 팔커크 휠이 배를 '어떻게' 옮기는지 설명하는 것이므로, 작동 방식(배가 물이 찬 곤돌라에 들어가고 바퀴가 회전해 위아래로 운반)을 담은 C가 정답이다. A는 개통 연도와 수위 차이만 제시할 뿐 작동 방식을 설명하지 않는다. B는 휠 건설 이전의 상황을 말하므로 휠의 작동 원리와 무관하다. D는 '회전하는 보트 리프트'라고만 소개하고 메모에 없는 평가를 덧붙였을 뿐, 배가 실제로 어떻게 이동하는지는 설명하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to explain how the Falkirk Wheel moves boats, so you need the note describing the process: boats float into a water-filled gondola and the wheel turns to carry them up or down. Choice C does exactly that, so it is correct. Choice A gives the opening date and the height difference, but it doesn't say how boats are moved. Choice B describes what boats had to do before the wheel existed, not how the wheel works. Choice D only calls it a rotating boat lift and adds a claim that isn't in the notes, without explaining how the boats actually move.

hardJudge.note: 정답 C 검산: 목표(작동 방식 설명)에 부합하는 메모(곤돌라에 띄워 넣고 바퀴 회전) 사용. A는 연도·수위 차, B는 건설 이전 상황, D는 정체 소개+메모 밖 평가로 명확히 배제되며 전형적 오답 패턴. 해설 한·영 동일 결론, 글자 참조 일치, 한글 없음. 팔커크 휠 사실관계(2002 개통, 24m, 11 locks, 4분 반회전) 정확. 메모 형식·문항 형식 SAT 표준에 부합. 난이도 easy 적합.

advisory.note: 사실관계(2002년 개통, 수위 차 약 24m, 예전에는 갑문 11개로 하루 가까이 소요, 반 바퀴에 약 4분)가 맞다. 목표와 직접 일치하는 단서가 하나뿐인 easy 수준 문항이다. 오답 선택지는 모두 메모에 있는 관련 정보라서 그럴듯하다. 다만 D에는 메모에 없는 평가가 들어가 있어 조금 쉽게 배제된다.

problem.passage:
Most desert plants survive dry seasons by storing water in thick stems or leaves. The resurrection fern takes a very different approach. During a drought, its fronds curl up, turn brown, and lose nearly all of their water, so the plant looks completely dead. ______ within a day of a heavy rain, the same fronds absorb water, uncurl, and turn bright green again.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Most desert plants survive dry seasons by storing water in thick stems or leaves. The resurrection fern takes a very different approach. During a drought, its fronds curl up, turn brown, and lose nearly all of their water, so the plant looks completely dead. ______ within a day of a heavy rain, the same fronds absorb water, uncurl, and turn bright green again.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 문장은 가뭄 때 고사리가 완전히 죽은 것처럼 보인다고 하고, 뒤 문장은 비가 오면 다시 초록색으로 살아난다고 말하므로 두 문장은 대조 관계이다. 따라서 대조를 나타내는 B가 정답이다. A는 뒤 문장이 앞 내용의 예시가 아니므로 틀리다. C는 두 상태가 비슷하지 않고 정반대이므로 틀리다. D는 죽은 듯 보이는 것이 다시 살아나는 원인이 아니라 비가 원인이므로 틀리다.
problem.explanationEn: The sentence before the blank says the fern looks completely dead during a drought, and the sentence after it says the fern turns green again after rain, so the two sentences contrast. That's why B, which signals contrast, is correct. A is wrong because the second sentence isn't an example of the first. C is wrong because the two states are opposites, not similar. D is wrong because looking dead doesn't cause the recovery; the rain does.

hardJudge.note: 앞 문장(죽은 듯 보임)과 뒤 문장(비 오면 다시 초록색으로 회복)은 명확한 대조 관계이므로 However가 유일하게 논리적임. 오답은 예시·유사·인과라는 전형적 전환어 오개념으로 구성되어 easy 기준에 부합. 해설 한·영 모두 정답 글자와 논리가 일치하고 모순 없음. 부활고사리의 생태 서술도 사실과 부합.

advisory.note: 'looks completely dead'와 'turn bright green again'의 대조가 지문에 분명히 드러나 있다. 오답은 예시·유사·인과를 나타내는 연결어로, 흔히 헷갈리는 선택지들이다. 사실관계도 맞다(부활고사리는 건조 시 수분을 크게 잃었다가 비가 오면 하루 안에 회복한다).

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The axolotl is a type of salamander.
- It lives only in a few lakes and canals near Mexico City.
- Unlike most salamanders, the axolotl keeps its feathery gills as an adult.
- Axolotls can regrow lost limbs, parts of the heart, and even parts of the brain.
- Scientists study axolotls to learn how tissue regrowth might work in humans.

The student wants to explain why scientists are interested in the axolotl. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The axolotl is a type of salamander.
- It lives only in a few lakes and canals near Mexico City.
- Unlike most salamanders, the axolotl keeps its feathery gills as an adult.
- Axolotls can regrow lost limbs, parts of the heart, and even parts of the brain.
- Scientists study axolotls to learn how tissue regrowth might work in humans.
problem.question: The student wants to explain why scientists are interested in the axolotl. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: The axolotl, a type of salamander, lives only in a few lakes and canals near Mexico City.
Unlike most salamanders, the axolotl keeps its feathery gills even as an adult.
The axolotl is a salamander that keeps its feathery gills and lives near Mexico City.
Because axolotls can regrow limbs and even parts of the heart and brain, scientists study them to learn how tissue regrowth might work in humans.
problem.explanation: 목표는 과학자들이 아롤로틀에 관심을 갖는 '이유'를 설명하는 것이다. D는 재생 능력과 그것이 인간의 조직 재생 연구에 쓰인다는 메모를 연결해 이유를 직접 제시한다. A는 서식지만 소개할 뿐 과학자의 관심과 무관하다. B는 아가미의 특징만 말하고 연구 이유를 밝히지 않는다. C는 여러 사실을 묶었지만 역시 과학자들이 연구하는 이유는 빠져 있다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to explain why scientists are interested in the axolotl. D does this by linking the axolotl's ability to regrow body parts to the reason scientists study it: learning how tissue regrowth might work in humans. A only tells you where the axolotl lives, which has nothing to do with scientific interest. B describes its gills but never says why scientists study it. C combines several facts, but it still leaves out the reason for scientific interest.

hardJudge.note: D만이 재생 능력과 인간 조직 재생 연구라는 '이유'를 연결하며, A·B·C는 메모의 사실을 정확히 반영하되 과학자의 관심 이유를 담지 않아 규칙(목표 일치) 하나로 배제된다. 메모 내용 사실관계도 정확하고(아홀로틀 유형성숙, 재생 연구), 한·영 해설 결론 및 글자 참조 일치. 영어 해설에 한글 없음. D가 다른 선택지보다 길어 다소 눈에 띄는 점은 있으나 실제 SAT easy 문항에서도 흔한 패턴이므로 난이도 적합.

advisory.note: 메모 하나(과학자들이 연구한다)와 목표를 연결하면 바로 풀리는 easy 문항이다. 오답은 모두 메모 내용과 맞지만 목표와 관련 없는 전형적 오답이다. 고칠 점은 한글 표기 오타 하나뿐이다.

problem.passage:
Mangrove forests grow along tropical coastlines where land meets salty seawater. Their thick, tangled roots slow down incoming waves and hold muddy soil in place during storms. ______ villages located behind healthy mangrove forests often suffer much less flood damage than villages on unprotected shores.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Mangrove forests grow along tropical coastlines where land meets salty seawater. Their thick, tangled roots slow down incoming waves and hold muddy soil in place during storms. ______ villages located behind healthy mangrove forests often suffer much less flood damage than villages on unprotected shores.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 맹그로브 뿌리가 폭풍 때 파도를 늦추고 흙을 붙잡아 준다고 말하고, 뒤 문장은 맹그로브 뒤에 있는 마을의 홍수 피해가 적다고 말한다. 뒤 문장은 앞 문장의 결과이므로 정답은 D이다. A는 대조를 나타내지만 두 문장은 서로 반대되지 않는다. B는 예시를 나타내지만 피해 감소는 뿌리의 작용을 보여 주는 사례가 아니라 그 작용이 낳은 결과이다. C는 비슷한 다른 사실을 덧붙일 때 쓰지만 뒤 문장은 새롭게 비교할 대상을 제시하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The first sentences tell you that mangrove roots slow waves and hold soil in place during storms, and the last sentence says villages behind mangroves suffer less flood damage. Less damage is the consequence of that protection, so D is correct. A signals a contrast, but the two ideas don't oppose each other. B introduces an example, but the reduced damage isn't a case of the roots' action; it's the outcome of that action. C adds a similar but separate point, and the last sentence doesn't bring in anything new to compare.

hardJudge.note: 앞 문장(뿌리가 파도를 늦추고 흙을 붙잡음) → 뒤 문장(마을 홍수 피해 감소)은 명확한 인과 관계이므로 D 'As a result'가 정답. A(대조), C(유사 추가)는 명백히 배제되고 B(예시)는 전형적 오개념으로 그럴듯함. 한·영 해설 모두 D를 일관되게 뒷받침하며 글자 참조 일치, 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 맹그로브 관련 사실도 정확. 단일 규칙·한 단계 추론으로 easy 적합.

advisory.note: 명확한 인과 관계라서 한 단계 추론으로 풀 수 있다. B(예시)는 그럴듯한 오답으로 작동한다. 다만 '홍수 피해 감소'를 '보호 작용의 사례'로 읽을 여지가 아주 조금 있다. 그래도 D가 가장 논리적이라는 점은 분명하다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Clara Whitfield is a contemporary British novelist.
- Her 2019 novel The Lamplighter's Daughter is set in a foggy coastal town in 1860s Cornwall.
- The novel is written in long, formal sentences that imitate the style of nineteenth-century fiction.
- Its main character, Agnes Penrose, secretly teaches herself to read using her father's ledgers.
- Whitfield worked as a schoolteacher in Leeds before becoming a full-time writer.

The student wants to describe the writing style of The Lamplighter's Daughter. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Clara Whitfield is a contemporary British novelist.
- Her 2019 novel The Lamplighter's Daughter is set in a foggy coastal town in 1860s Cornwall.
- The novel is written in long, formal sentences that imitate the style of nineteenth-century fiction.
- Its main character, Agnes Penrose, secretly teaches herself to read using her father's ledgers.
- Whitfield worked as a schoolteacher in Leeds before becoming a full-time writer.
problem.question: The student wants to describe the writing style of The Lamplighter's Daughter. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Clara Whitfield's The Lamplighter's Daughter uses long, formal sentences that imitate the style of nineteenth-century fiction.
Clara Whitfield's The Lamplighter's Daughter, published in 2019, is set in a foggy coastal town in 1860s Cornwall.
In The Lamplighter's Daughter, Agnes Penrose secretly teaches herself to read using her father's ledgers.
Before writing The Lamplighter's Daughter, Clara Whitfield worked as a schoolteacher in Leeds.
problem.explanation: 목표는 소설의 '문체(writing style)'를 묘사하는 것이다. A는 길고 격식 있는 문장으로 19세기 소설을 모방한다는 메모를 사용해 문체를 직접 설명하므로 정답이다. B는 배경(시간·장소)을 설명할 뿐 문체를 다루지 않는다. C는 주인공의 줄거리 내용이고, D는 작가의 경력에 관한 정보라 목표와 무관하다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to describe the novel's writing style. A uses the note about long, formal sentences that imitate nineteenth-century fiction, so it describes the style directly and is correct. B tells you the setting (time and place), not how the book is written. C gives a plot detail about the main character, and D gives a fact about the author's career, so neither one is about style.

hardJudge.note: 가상의 작가·작품으로 저작권 문제 없음. 목표(문체 묘사)에 직접 대응하는 메모는 세 번째 하나뿐이며 A가 이를 정확히 사용. B(배경), C(줄거리), D(작가 경력)는 모두 메모에 충실하지만 목표와 무관한 전형적 오답으로 기능. 한 가지 규칙(목표 일치 여부)만으로 풀리므로 easy에 적합. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 선택지 참조가 일치하고 결론이 동일함.

advisory.note: 가상의 작가·작품이다. 목표(문체)와 맞는 메모가 하나뿐이라 한 단계로 풀 수 있다. 오답은 배경·줄거리·작가 경력으로 이루어진 전형적인 오답 유형이다. 난이도 easy에 맞다.

problem.passage:
Early bridges in many mountain villages were built from rope and wooden planks, which wore out quickly in wet weather. Villagers often had to replace the planks every few years. In the 1990s, engineers in Nepal began designing footbridges with steel cables and metal decking that resist rain and rot. ______ these newer bridges can last for decades with only basic maintenance.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Early bridges in many mountain villages were built from rope and wooden planks, which wore out quickly in wet weather. Villagers often had to replace the planks every few years. In the 1990s, engineers in Nepal began designing footbridges with steel cables and metal decking that resist rain and rot. ______ these newer bridges can last for decades with only basic maintenance.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 문장은 강철 케이블과 금속 상판이 비와 부식에 견딘다는 원인을, 빈칸 뒤 문장은 그 덕분에 다리가 수십 년간 유지된다는 결과를 제시하므로 인과를 나타내는 B가 정답이다. A는 대조를 나타내지만 두 문장은 서로 반대되지 않는다. C는 예시를 소개하는데, 뒤 문장은 앞 내용의 사례가 아니라 결과이다. D는 유사한 다른 대상을 덧붙일 때 쓰지만 여기서는 같은 다리에 대한 이야기가 이어진다.
problem.explanationEn: The sentence before the blank gives a cause: the steel cables and metal decking resist rain and rot. The sentence after the blank gives the effect: the bridges last for decades. That cause-and-effect link makes B correct. A signals a contrast, but the two sentences don't oppose each other. C introduces an example, but the second sentence states a result, not an instance of the first idea. D signals a comparison with something similar, but both sentences are about the same bridges.

hardJudge.note: 앞 문장(재료가 비·부식에 강함)→뒤 문장(수십 년 지속)의 명확한 인과 관계로 B가 유일하게 성립. However는 대조 아님, For example은 예시 아님, Similarly는 비교 대상 없음. 해설 한·영 모두 글자 참조 일치, 한글 혼입 없음. 지문은 일반적 사실(네팔 1990년대 강철 보행교)로 저작권 우려 없음. 단일 규칙(인과 연결어)으로 한 단계 추론, 평이한 어휘 — easy에 적합.

advisory.note: The blank sets up a single cause-and-effect step: the materials resist rain and rot, so the bridges last a long time. The wrong answers are believable. "However" can look right because the old and new bridges contrast. But the sentence just before the blank is already about the new bridges, so there's no contrast at the blank. The historical claim ("in the 1990s") is general background and isn't needed to solve the item.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- In the 1800s, many cities in Europe had no public lending libraries open to working people.
- In 1850, the British Parliament passed the Public Libraries Act.
- The act allowed town councils to collect a small tax to fund free public libraries.
- Manchester opened one of the first libraries under the act in 1852.
- Before the act, most libraries charged membership fees that many workers could not afford.

The student wants to explain what the Public Libraries Act allowed towns to do. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- In the 1800s, many cities in Europe had no public lending libraries open to working people.
- In 1850, the British Parliament passed the Public Libraries Act.
- The act allowed town councils to collect a small tax to fund free public libraries.
- Manchester opened one of the first libraries under the act in 1852.
- Before the act, most libraries charged membership fees that many workers could not afford.
problem.question: The student wants to explain what the Public Libraries Act allowed towns to do. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Manchester opened one of the first libraries under the Public Libraries Act in 1852.
Before 1850, most libraries charged membership fees that many workers could not afford.
The Public Libraries Act of 1850 allowed town councils to collect a small tax to fund free public libraries.
In the 1800s, many European cities had no public lending libraries open to working people.
problem.explanation: 목표는 공공도서관법이 도시에 무엇을 허용했는지 설명하는 것이다. C는 이 법이 시의회가 소액의 세금을 걷어 무료 공공도서관 운영 자금을 마련하도록 허용했다고 직접 밝히므로 정답이다. A는 이 법에 따라 도서관이 문을 연 한 사례만 제시할 뿐, 법이 무엇을 허용했는지는 설명하지 않는다. B와 D는 법이 생기기 전의 상황을 설명하므로 법의 내용을 다루지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to explain what the Public Libraries Act allowed towns to do. C is correct because it directly states that the act let town councils collect a small tax to fund free public libraries. A gives only one example of a library that opened under the act, but it doesn't say what the act allowed. B and D describe conditions before the act, so they don't explain what the law itself did.

hardJudge.note: 목표("법이 허용한 것")와 C의 "allowed town councils to collect a small tax to fund free public libraries"가 직접 대응. A는 사례, B·D는 법 이전 상황이라 전형적 오답으로 기능. 1850 Public Libraries Act·1852 Manchester 개관은 역사적 사실과 일치. 영어 해설은 한국어 해설과 동일 결론·글자 참조이며 자연스럽고 한글 없음. 노트 어휘 평이, 단일 규칙(목표-정보 직접 대응)으로 해결 가능하여 easy에 적합.

advisory.note: 정답 C만 법이 허용한 내용(지방세 징수로 무료 도서관 재원 마련)을 진술함. A는 사례, B·D는 배경으로, 목표와 관련된 그럴듯한 오답임. 사실관계(1850년 법, 1852년 맨체스터 개관)도 정확함. easy 난이도에 적합함.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Lake Baikal is located in southern Siberia, Russia.
- It is the deepest lake in the world, reaching a maximum depth of about 1,642 meters.
- The lake holds roughly 20 percent of the world's unfrozen fresh surface water.
- More than 300 rivers and streams flow into Lake Baikal.
- The Baikal seal, or nerpa, is one of the few seal species that lives only in fresh water.

The student wants to emphasize how much fresh water Lake Baikal contains. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Lake Baikal is located in southern Siberia, Russia.
- It is the deepest lake in the world, reaching a maximum depth of about 1,642 meters.
- The lake holds roughly 20 percent of the world's unfrozen fresh surface water.
- More than 300 rivers and streams flow into Lake Baikal.
- The Baikal seal, or nerpa, is one of the few seal species that lives only in fresh water.
problem.question: The student wants to emphasize how much fresh water Lake Baikal contains. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Lake Baikal, located in southern Siberia, is home to the Baikal seal, one of the few seals that live only in fresh water.
Lake Baikal holds roughly 20 percent of the world's unfrozen fresh surface water.
More than 300 rivers and streams flow into Lake Baikal in southern Siberia, Russia.
Reaching a maximum depth of about 1,642 meters, Lake Baikal is the deepest lake in the world.
problem.explanation: 목표는 바이칼호가 담고 있는 담수의 양을 강조하는 것이다. B는 바이칼호가 세계의 얼지 않은 지표 담수의 약 20퍼센트를 담고 있다고 말해 물의 양을 직접 보여 준다. A는 담수에 사는 물범을 소개할 뿐 물의 양은 다루지 않는다. C의 유입 하천 수는 물이 어디서 오는지를 말할 뿐 호수에 물이 얼마나 있는지는 알려 주지 않는다. D의 깊이는 인상적이지만 담고 있는 물의 양이 아니라 깊이에 관한 정보이다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to emphasize how much fresh water Lake Baikal contains. B does this directly by stating that the lake holds roughly 20 percent of the world's unfrozen fresh surface water. A introduces the freshwater seal, but it says nothing about the amount of water. C tells you how many rivers flow into the lake, which describes where the water comes from, not how much the lake holds. D is about the lake's depth, which is impressive but is not a statement about the amount of water it contains.

hardJudge.note: 정답 B는 '담수의 양'이라는 목표를 유일하게 직접 충족하며, 노트의 사실(20%, 1,642m, 300여 하천, 네르파)은 실제 알려진 정보와 일치한다. 오답은 각각 담수 관련 생물(A), 유입 하천(C), 깊이(D)로 목표와 인접하지만 '양'을 말하지 않는 전형적 오개념 선택지로 적절하다. 한·영 해설 결론과 글자 참조가 일치하고 영어 해설에 한글 없음. easy 난이도에 부합.

advisory.note: 사실(깊이 약 1,642m, 지표 담수 약 20%, 유입 하천 300여 개, 담수 물범 네르파) 정확. 목표와 직결되는 노트가 하나라 easy에 적합. D(깊이)와 C(유입 하천)는 '물의 양'과 헷갈릴 수 있는 그럴듯한 오답.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The bluehead wrasse (Thalassoma bifasciatum) is a small reef fish found in the western Atlantic Ocean.
- Most bluehead wrasses begin life as females.
- When the dominant male of a group disappears, the largest female in the group can change sex and become a male.
- This change begins within hours: the fish starts showing male courtship behavior almost immediately.
- Full transformation of the ovaries into functioning testes takes about 8 to 10 days.

The student wants to emphasize how quickly a bluehead wrasse's behavior changes compared with its physical transformation. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The bluehead wrasse (Thalassoma bifasciatum) is a small reef fish found in the western Atlantic Ocean.
- Most bluehead wrasses begin life as females.
- When the dominant male of a group disappears, the largest female in the group can change sex and become a male.
- This change begins within hours: the fish starts showing male courtship behavior almost immediately.
- Full transformation of the ovaries into functioning testes takes about 8 to 10 days.
problem.question: The student wants to emphasize how quickly a bluehead wrasse's behavior changes compared with its physical transformation. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: When a group of bluehead wrasses loses its dominant male, the largest female can change sex, a process that ends with her ovaries becoming functioning testes.
Bluehead wrasses, small reef fish of the western Atlantic, mostly begin life as females, but the largest female in a group can become a male within 8 to 10 days.
Although a bluehead wrasse's ovaries need about 8 to 10 days to become functioning testes, the fish begins displaying male courtship behavior within hours of its sex change starting.
Within hours of a dominant male's disappearance, the largest female bluehead wrasse in the group begins to change sex and show male courtship behavior.
problem.explanation: 목표는 행동 변화의 속도와 신체 변화의 속도를 대조하는 것이므로, '몇 시간 내' 구애 행동과 '8~10일' 생식선 변화를 함께 제시해야 한다. C는 두 시간 정보를 Although로 대조하여 목표를 정확히 달성한다. A는 신체 변화만 언급하고 시간 정보가 없다. B는 8~10일만 제시하고 행동 변화의 빠름을 빠뜨린다. D는 몇 시간 내 행동 변화는 말하지만 신체 변화의 느린 속도와 비교하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to contrast how fast the behavior changes with how fast the body changes, so the sentence needs both the "within hours" behavior detail and the "8 to 10 days" detail about the ovaries. C puts these two timeframes side by side with "Although," so it meets the goal exactly. A describes only the physical change and gives no timing. B gives only the 8-to-10-day figure and leaves out how quickly the behavior changes. D points out the fast behavioral change but never compares it with the slower physical transformation.

hardJudge.note: C만이 '몇 시간 내' 행동 변화와 '8~10일' 신체 변화를 Although로 대조하여 목표(속도 비교)를 달성함. B(8~10일만)·D(몇 시간만)는 각각 한쪽 시간 정보만 담아 부분적으로 맞는 오답이며, A는 시간 정보 없음. 두 노트 항목을 결합해야 하는 medium 수준에 적합. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답 및 선택지 참조가 일치하고 자연스러움. 사실관계(행동 변화 수 시간, 생식선 변화 약 8~10일)도 통상 알려진 내용과 부합.

advisory.note: C만 두 시간 정보(몇 시간 내 행동 변화, 8~10일 신체 변화)를 대조해 제시한다. B와 D는 각각 정보 하나만 담고 있어 그럴듯한 오답으로 기능하고, A는 시간 정보가 없다. 사실관계도 대체로 정확하다(블루헤드 놀래기의 행동 변화는 몇 분~몇 시간 내에 시작되고, 생식선 전환에는 약 8~10일이 걸린다). B의 '8~10일 만에 수컷이 된다'는 표현은 대략적이지만 수용 가능한 수준이다.

problem.passage:
When engineers at a Dutch shipyard began testing hull coatings that release tiny air bubbles along a vessel's underside, they expected the bubble layer to cut drag by reducing contact between the hull and the water. In calm harbor trials, the coating performed as predicted, lowering fuel use by nearly eight percent. ______ in open-sea trials, where waves repeatedly broke up the bubble layer before it could spread along the hull, fuel savings shrank to less than two percent.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: When engineers at a Dutch shipyard began testing hull coatings that release tiny air bubbles along a vessel's underside, they expected the bubble layer to cut drag by reducing contact between the hull and the water. In calm harbor trials, the coating performed as predicted, lowering fuel use by nearly eight percent. ______ in open-sea trials, where waves repeatedly broke up the bubble layer before it could spread along the hull, fuel savings shrank to less than two percent.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 잔잔한 항구 시험에서 코팅이 예상대로 연료를 약 8% 줄였다고 말하고, 뒤 문장은 파도가 거친 외해에서는 절감 효과가 2% 미만으로 줄었다고 말한다. 두 결과가 서로 대비되므로 대조를 나타내는 B가 정답이다. A는 외해의 결과가 항구 시험 성공에서 비롯된 것처럼 만들지만, 실제 원인은 파도가 기포층을 흩어 놓은 것이다. C는 두 결과가 비슷하다는 뜻이 되는데, 둘 다 연료 절감 수치이긴 해도 그 크기는 크게 다르다. D는 외해 시험을 항구 시험 결과의 예시로 제시하게 되지만, 오히려 그 결과와 어긋나는 사례이다.
problem.explanationEn: The sentence before the blank says the coating cut fuel use by nearly eight percent in calm harbor trials. The sentence after it says the savings fell below two percent in rough open-sea trials. Because these results contrast, B is the best choice. A would mean the open-sea result was caused by the harbor success, but the text says the real cause was waves breaking up the bubble layer. C would mean the two results were alike, but even though both are fuel savings, their sizes are very different. D would make the open-sea trial an example of the harbor result, when it actually goes against that result.

hardJudge.note: 앞 문장(항구 시험 약 8% 절감, 예측대로)과 뒤 문장(외해 시험 2% 미만)이 명확히 대비되므로 B "However,"가 정답임을 직접 확인. 문장 결합("However, in open-sea trials, where ...")도 문법적으로 자연스러움. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 같은 결론과 글자 참조(A/C/D 배제 근거)를 가지며 모순 없음, 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 오답 A는 뒤 문장의 인과 서술(파도가 기포층을 흩음) 때문에, C는 두 문장 모두 연료 절감 수치를 제시한다는 점에서 부분적 근거가 있어 비교가 필요하고, D도 '시험 사례'라는 틀에서 말이 됨. 정답이 정독 시 명확하고 두 결과의 연결·대비 판단을 요구하므로 medium에 적합. 저작권 의심 없음(독창적 가상 시나리오), 사실 오류 없음.

advisory.note: 대조가 8% 대 2% 미만으로 너무 뚜렷하다. 'calm harbor'와 'open-sea, waves'의 대비까지 겹쳐 훑어 읽어도 However가 바로 보인다. 오답 중 Similarly와 For example은 쉽게 배제되고, 부분 근거를 가진 오답은 Consequently(파도라는 원인 연결) 정도뿐이라 medium 기준(부분 근거 오답 2개 이상)에 미치지 못한다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Novelist Harriet Vane-Osgood published Ashcombe Hall in 2019 and The Lamplighter's Daughter in 2023.
- Both novels are written in the style of nineteenth-century English fiction, with long chapters and an intrusive narrator who comments on the characters.
- Ashcombe Hall is set entirely on a declining country estate in Yorkshire.
- The Lamplighter's Daughter follows its heroine through the crowded streets of Victorian London.
- Ashcombe Hall is told by a narrator who claims to have known the family personally.
- The Lamplighter's Daughter is narrated by an anonymous voice that never appears in the story.

The student wants to emphasize a difference in how the two novels are narrated. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Novelist Harriet Vane-Osgood published Ashcombe Hall in 2019 and The Lamplighter's Daughter in 2023.
- Both novels are written in the style of nineteenth-century English fiction, with long chapters and an intrusive narrator who comments on the characters.
- Ashcombe Hall is set entirely on a declining country estate in Yorkshire.
- The Lamplighter's Daughter follows its heroine through the crowded streets of Victorian London.
- Ashcombe Hall is told by a narrator who claims to have known the family personally.
- The Lamplighter's Daughter is narrated by an anonymous voice that never appears in the story.
problem.question: The student wants to emphasize a difference in how the two novels are narrated. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Ashcombe Hall takes place on a Yorkshire country estate, whereas The Lamplighter's Daughter moves through the crowded streets of Victorian London.
Both of Harriet Vane-Osgood's novels, Ashcombe Hall and The Lamplighter's Daughter, feature an intrusive narrator who comments on the characters.
Harriet Vane-Osgood's 2023 novel The Lamplighter's Daughter is narrated by an anonymous voice and follows its heroine through Victorian London.

Although both of Harriet Vane-Osgood's novels use an intrusive narrator, Ashcombe Hall's narrator claims a personal acquaintance with the family, while The Lamplighter's Daughter's narrator remains an anonymous voice outside the story.
problem.explanation: 목표는 두 소설의 '서술 방식'의 차이를 강조하는 것이다. D는 한 화자는 가족을 직접 안다고 주장하고, 다른 화자는 이야기 밖의 익명 목소리라는 점을 대조하여 목표를 달성한다. A는 차이를 제시하지만 서술이 아니라 배경의 차이이다. B는 서술을 다루지만 공통점만 말한다. C는 서술 정보를 담고 있으나 한 소설만 언급해 차이를 보여 주지 못한다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to emphasize a difference in how the two novels are narrated. D does this by contrasting a narrator who claims to know the family personally with an anonymous voice outside the story. A does present a contrast, but it is about setting, not narration. B is about narration, but it describes only something the novels share. C mentions how one novel is narrated, but because it discusses only one book, it can't show a difference.

hardJudge.note: D만이 두 소설의 서술 방식(화자가 가족과 안면 있음 vs. 이야기 밖 익명 목소리)의 차이를 명시적으로 대조한다. A는 배경의 차이(서술 아님), B는 서술의 공통점, C는 한 소설만 다룸. 세 오답이 각각 '차이', '서술', '서술 정보'라는 부분적 근거를 지녀 비교 배제가 필요하므로 medium에 적합. 노트와 선택지·해설이 모순 없이 일치하며, 가상의 작가/작품으로 저작권 문제 없음. 한국어·영어 해설 결론과 글자 참조가 일치하고 영어는 자연스러움.

advisory.note: 가상 작가·작품. 오답 A(차이지만 배경), B(서술이지만 공통점), C(서술이지만 한 작품)가 각각 부분적으로 맞아 비교가 필요하므로 medium에 적합하다. D가 다른 선택지보다 눈에 띄게 길어 정답 단서가 될 수 있다는 점은 사소한 문제다.

problem.passage:
Along the coast of Bangladesh, many villages sit behind earthen embankments built in the 1960s to keep tidal water off farmland. The barriers succeeded in protecting crops from salt water, but they also blocked the sediment that tides once spread across the land. Over the following decades, the enclosed fields slowly sank while riverbeds outside the walls rose. ______ some communities have begun experimenting with "tidal river management," deliberately opening embankments for a few years so that sediment-laden water can rebuild the land's surface.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Along the coast of Bangladesh, many villages sit behind earthen embankments built in the 1960s to keep tidal water off farmland. The barriers succeeded in protecting crops from salt water, but they also blocked the sediment that tides once spread across the land. Over the following decades, the enclosed fields slowly sank while riverbeds outside the walls rose. ______ some communities have begun experimenting with "tidal river management," deliberately opening embankments for a few years so that sediment-laden water can rebuild the land's surface.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장들은 제방 때문에 퇴적물이 차단되어 땅이 가라앉았다는 문제를 설명하고, 빈칸 뒤 문장은 퇴적물로 땅을 다시 쌓으려고 제방을 일부러 여는 실험을 소개합니다. 이는 문제에 대한 대응이므로 A가 정답입니다. B는 지문에 'but'이 있어 대조처럼 보이지만, 땅이 가라앉았는데도 불구하고 제방을 연다는 뜻이 되어 논리가 맞지 않습니다. 이 실험은 오히려 땅이 가라앉았기 때문에 시작된 것입니다. C는 빈칸 뒤 내용이 앞에 나온 일반적 주장의 사례가 아니라 새로운 조치이므로 맞지 않습니다. D는 제방을 여는 것이 제방을 쌓은 것과 비슷한 일이 아니라 그 결과를 바로잡는 일이므로 맞지 않습니다.
problem.explanationEn: The earlier sentences describe a problem: the embankments blocked sediment, so the fields sank. The sentence after the blank describes communities opening the embankments on purpose so sediment can rebuild the land. That is a reaction to the problem, so A is correct. B may look right because the passage contains "but," but it would mean the communities acted despite the sinking, when they actually acted because of it. C doesn't work because the new practice is not an example of a general claim made earlier; it is a new step taken in response. D doesn't work because opening the embankments is not similar to building them; it is a way to fix what building them caused.

hardJudge.note: 문제(제방→퇴적물 차단→침하) 뒤 대응 조치(제방 개방)로 이어지므로 'In response'가 정확. B는 지문의 'but'에 끌려 고를 수 있는 매력적 오답, C·D도 그럴듯하나 비교로 배제됨. 해설 한·영 모두 결론·글자 참조 일치, 한글 없음. 방글라데시 tidal river management는 실제 사례로 사실 오류 없음.

advisory.note: 문제→대응 관계가 분명하고 A가 유일한 정답이다. B(Nevertheless)는 앞 문장의 'but'과 '제방을 연다/쌓았다'는 반전 때문에 대조로 읽힐 여지가 있어 매력적인 오답이다. D(Similarly)도 '제방 관련 조치'라는 겉모습이 비슷해 약간 끌리는 면이 있다. C(For instance)는 비교적 쉽게 걸러진다. medium 하단에 해당하지만 기준 범위 안이라고 판단한다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- In the nineteenth century, many European cities began building public washhouses where working-class residents could do laundry and bathe.
- Liverpool opened Britain's first public washhouse in 1842, largely through the efforts of Kitty Wilkinson, an Irish-born resident.
- During an 1832 cholera outbreak, Wilkinson had let neighbors use her own boiler to wash contaminated bedding.
- The Liverpool washhouse charged users one penny per hour.
- Paris's first large municipal washhouse, opened in the 1850s, was financed directly by the national government under Napoleon III.
- Unlike the Liverpool washhouse, the Paris facility was planned by officials rather than inspired by a local resident's example.

The student wants to contrast how the Liverpool and Paris washhouses originated. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- In the nineteenth century, many European cities began building public washhouses where working-class residents could do laundry and bathe.
- Liverpool opened Britain's first public washhouse in 1842, largely through the efforts of Kitty Wilkinson, an Irish-born resident.
- During an 1832 cholera outbreak, Wilkinson had let neighbors use her own boiler to wash contaminated bedding.
- The Liverpool washhouse charged users one penny per hour.
- Paris's first large municipal washhouse, opened in the 1850s, was financed directly by the national government under Napoleon III.
- Unlike the Liverpool washhouse, the Paris facility was planned by officials rather than inspired by a local resident's example.
problem.question: The student wants to contrast how the Liverpool and Paris washhouses originated. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Liverpool opened Britain's first public washhouse in 1842, charging users one penny per hour, while Paris opened its first large municipal washhouse in the 1850s.
Liverpool's 1842 washhouse grew out of resident Kitty Wilkinson's grassroots efforts, whereas Paris's washhouse of the 1850s was planned by officials and funded by Napoleon III's government.
During an 1832 cholera outbreak, Kitty Wilkinson let neighbors use her boiler, an act that later inspired Liverpool's 1842 public washhouse.
In the nineteenth century, cities such as Liverpool and Paris built public washhouses so that working-class residents could do laundry and bathe.
problem.explanation: 목표는 두 세탁장의 '기원(생겨난 방식)'을 대조하는 것이다. B는 리버풀은 주민 위킨슨의 노력에서, 파리는 관료의 계획과 정부 재정에서 시작되었다는 차이를 대조 접속어 whereas로 분명히 보여 준다. A는 두 도시를 모두 언급하지만 개장 연도와 이용료만 나열할 뿐 기원의 차이를 다루지 않는다. C는 리버풀의 기원을 정확히 설명하지만 파리를 빠뜨려 대조가 되지 않는다. D는 두 도시의 공통 목적만 말해서 대조가 아니라 유사점을 드러낸다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to contrast how the two washhouses originated. B does this directly: Liverpool's came from resident Kitty Wilkinson's grassroots efforts, while Paris's was planned by officials and paid for by the government, and "whereas" marks the contrast. A names both cities, but it only lists opening dates and a fee, so it never says how either washhouse came about. C explains Liverpool's origin accurately but leaves out Paris, so nothing is being contrasted. D points to what the two cities had in common, not how they differed.

hardJudge.note: 정답 B 검산 완료: 노트의 '위킨슨의 노력'과 '관료 계획·나폴레옹 3세 정부 재정'을 정확히 반영하여 기원을 대조한다. A는 두 도시를 대조 구조(while)로 제시하지만 연도·요금만 다루어 기원 누락, C는 리버풀 기원만 다루어 파리 누락, D는 공통점 서술로 모두 타당하게 배제된다. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 B를 일관되게 뒷받침하며 글자 참조 일치, 영어 해설에 한글 없음. A·C가 부분적 근거를 가진 오답으로 설계되어 medium에 적합.

advisory.note: 정답이 명확하다. A(두 도시 언급, 기원 없음)와 C(기원 언급, 한 도시만)는 부분적으로 맞는 근거가 있는 오답이고, D는 유사점만 말하므로 배제가 쉽다. medium 기준(오답 중 최소 2개가 부분적으로 그럴듯함)을 충족한다. 'grassroots'는 메모 내용(주민의 본보기와 노력)에서 무리 없이 추론할 수 있는 표현이다.

problem.passage:
Glaciologists studying the Tasman Glacier in New Zealand long assumed that most of its retreat was driven by rising air temperatures melting the ice surface from above. Recent sonar surveys of the proglacial lake at the glacier's terminus, however, revealed that the lake has deepened by more than 50 meters in some places, allowing relatively warm lake water to undercut the ice front and cause large slabs to break away. ______ the researchers now argue that models projecting the glacier's future should account for lake-driven calving rather than relying primarily on surface melt estimates.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Glaciologists studying the Tasman Glacier in New Zealand long assumed that most of its retreat was driven by rising air temperatures melting the ice surface from above. Recent sonar surveys of the proglacial lake at the glacier's terminus, however, revealed that the lake has deepened by more than 50 meters in some places, allowing relatively warm lake water to undercut the ice front and cause large slabs to break away. ______ the researchers now argue that models projecting the glacier's future should account for lake-driven calving rather than relying primarily on surface melt estimates.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 호수가 깊어져 따뜻한 물이 빙하 앞면을 깎아 붕괴를 일으킨다는 새 증거를 제시하고, 빈칸 뒤 문장은 그 증거에 근거해 모델이 호수 주도 붕괴를 반영해야 한다는 결론을 내린다. 따라서 결과·귀결을 나타내는 C가 정답이다. A는 지문 앞부분의 '기존 가정 vs 새 발견' 대비에 끌리게 하지만, 빈칸 앞뒤 문장은 대립이 아니라 증거와 그에 따른 주장이므로 맞지 않는다. B는 뒤 문장이 앞 내용의 구체적 사례가 아니라 그로부터 도출된 제안이므로 틀리다. D는 뒤 문장이 앞 내용과 유사한 별개의 사실을 덧붙이는 것이 아니므로 적절하지 않다.
problem.explanationEn: The sentence before the blank gives new evidence: the lake has deepened, so warm water is undercutting the ice front and causing it to break apart. The sentence after the blank draws a conclusion from that evidence, saying models should include lake-driven calving. Because the second sentence is a consequence of the first, C is correct. A may be tempting because the passage does contrast the old assumption with the new finding, but the two sentences around the blank don't contrast with each other: one gives evidence, and the next gives a recommendation based on it. B is wrong because the second sentence is a recommendation drawn from the first, not a specific example of it. D is wrong because the second sentence doesn't add a separate, similar fact.

hardJudge.note: 빈칸 앞 문장(새 증거) → 뒤 문장(그에 따른 주장)은 명확한 인과·귀결 관계이므로 C 'Accordingly'가 정답임을 직접 확인. A는 지문 첫 부분의 '기존 가정 vs 새 발견' 대비에 끌리는 유인 오답으로 훑어 읽으면 선택하기 쉬워 2단계 판단(지문 전체 대비 vs 빈칸 전후 관계)을 요구함. B·D는 상대적으로 약한 오답이나 말은 되므로 medium 기준에 대체로 부합. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 동일 결론과 글자 참조를 가지며, 영어 해설에 한글 없음. Tasman Glacier의 호수 주도 붕괴 설명은 실제 연구 경향과 상충하지 않음. 지문은 자체 창작으로 보이며 저작권 의심 없음.

advisory.note: 증거에서 결론으로 이어지는 관계라 Accordingly가 명확하다. 지문에 기존 가정과 새 발견의 대비가 있어서 Nevertheless(A)가 그럴듯한 오답으로 작동한다. B와 D는 비교적 쉽게 배제된다. '50미터 이상 깊어짐' 수치는 확인하지 못했지만 가상 지문으로서 무리가 없다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The bombardier beetle (Brachinus) defends itself by spraying a hot chemical mixture from its abdomen.
- The beetle stores hydroquinones and hydrogen peroxide in one internal chamber.
- When threatened, it pushes these chemicals into a second chamber containing enzymes.
- The enzymes trigger a rapid reaction that heats the mixture to about 100°C.
- The spray comes out in rapid pulses (about 500 per second) rather than as a continuous stream.
- Researchers think the pulses let the beetle's tissues cool briefly between bursts, protecting the beetle from its own heat.

The student wants to explain how the bombardier beetle avoids harming itself with its defensive spray. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The bombardier beetle (Brachinus) defends itself by spraying a hot chemical mixture from its abdomen.
- The beetle stores hydroquinones and hydrogen peroxide in one internal chamber.
- When threatened, it pushes these chemicals into a second chamber containing enzymes.
- The enzymes trigger a rapid reaction that heats the mixture to about 100°C.
- The spray comes out in rapid pulses (about 500 per second) rather than as a continuous stream.
- Researchers think the pulses let the beetle's tissues cool briefly between bursts, protecting the beetle from its own heat.
problem.question: The student wants to explain how the bombardier beetle avoids harming itself with its defensive spray. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: The bombardier beetle keeps hydroquinones and hydrogen peroxide in one chamber, separate from the enzymes in a second chamber, until it is threatened.
When the bombardier beetle is threatened, enzymes trigger a rapid reaction that heats its defensive chemicals to about 100°C before they are sprayed.
The bombardier beetle releases its spray in about 500 pulses per second, a pattern that makes the hot chemical mixture especially effective against predators.
Although its spray reaches about 100°C, the bombardier beetle releases it in rapid pulses, which researchers think give the beetle's tissues brief moments to cool between bursts.
problem.explanation: 목표는 딱정벌레가 자기 분사물에 스스로 해를 입지 않는 방법을 설명하는 것이다. D는 분사물이 약 100°C라는 위험 요소와, 맥박식 분사가 분출 사이에 조직을 식혀 준다는 보호 방식을 결합해 목표를 정확히 달성한다. A는 화학물질을 따로 저장한다는 정확한 메모를 쓰지만, 열로부터 자신을 보호하는 방식이 아니라 반응이 일어나기 전의 저장 방식만 설명한다. B는 분사물이 뜨거워지는 과정만 다루고 자기 보호는 언급하지 않는다. C는 맥박식 분사라는 메모를 쓰지만, 그 목적을 포식자에 대한 효과로 잘못 제시하여 메모의 냉각 설명과 어긋난다.
problem.explanationEn: The goal is to explain how the beetle keeps from harming itself with its own spray. D does this by pairing the danger (a spray of about 100°C) with the protection (rapid pulses that researchers think let the beetle's tissues cool between bursts). A uses an accurate note about separate storage, but it only describes how the chemicals are kept before the reaction, not how the beetle protects itself from the heat. B explains how the spray gets hot but never mentions self-protection. C mentions the pulses, but it claims their purpose is to work better against predators, which doesn't match the notes' cooling explanation.

hardJudge.note: D는 위험(100°C)과 보호 기제(맥박식 분사→조직 냉각)를 메모 그대로 결합해 목표를 유일하게 충족한다. A는 '분리 저장'을 자기 보호로 오해할 수 있어 매력적인 오답이고, C는 맥박식 분사라는 핵심 메모를 쓰되 목적을 메모와 다르게 서술하여 비교가 필요하며, B도 메모에 충실해 말이 된다. 한·영 해설 모두 결론과 선택지 참조가 일치하고 영어 자연스럽다. 사실 관계(약 100°C, 초당 약 500회 펄스)도 실제 연구와 부합. 저작권 우려 없음.

advisory.note: A는 화학물질을 따로 저장하는 것도 자기 보호로 읽힐 여지가 있어 그럴듯한 오답이고, C는 맥박식 분사라는 같은 메모를 써서 비교해야 배제된다. 중간 난이도에 적합하다. 다만 "Brachinus"의 맥박식 분사는 실제 연구에서 주로 Stenaptinus/Brachinus 근거이며, 문항 메모 범위 안에서는 문제가 없다.

problem.passage:
When engineers in the Netherlands began testing self-healing concrete in the 2010s, they embedded dormant bacterial spores and calcium lactate in the mix. When water seeps into a crack, the spores activate and produce limestone that seals the gap. Early trials showed that cracks up to 0.8 millimeters wide could close within three weeks. ______ the material has seen only limited use in large infrastructure projects: it costs roughly twice as much as conventional concrete, and few long-term studies confirm that the bacteria survive for decades inside a structure.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: When engineers in the Netherlands began testing self-healing concrete in the 2010s, they embedded dormant bacterial spores and calcium lactate in the mix. When water seeps into a crack, the spores activate and produce limestone that seals the gap. Early trials showed that cracks up to 0.8 millimeters wide could close within three weeks. ______ the material has seen only limited use in large infrastructure projects: it costs roughly twice as much as conventional concrete, and few long-term studies confirm that the bacteria survive for decades inside a structure.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 초기 실험에서 균열이 3주 안에 메워졌다는 긍정적 결과를 말하고, 뒤 문장은 그럼에도 대형 사업에서 제한적으로만 쓰였다는 반대 방향의 사실과 이유(비용, 장기 연구 부족)를 제시하므로 양보 후 반전인 A가 정답이다. B는 성공적인 실험이 제한적 사용의 원인인 것처럼 만드는데, 실제 원인은 콜론 뒤의 비용과 불확실성이다. C는 뒤 문장이 앞 내용의 구체적 사례여야 하지만 새로운 한계를 제시한다. D는 유사한 내용을 덧붙일 때 쓰지만 두 문장은 대조된다.
problem.explanationEn: The previous sentence reports a promising result: cracks closed within three weeks in early trials. The next sentence turns the other way, saying the material is still rarely used in big projects and explaining why (high cost, few long-term studies). That is a concession followed by a contrast, so A is correct. B treats the successful trials as the cause of the limited use, but the real causes come after the colon. C would need the sentence to give an instance of the trial results, but it brings up new drawbacks instead. D signals a similar point, but the two sentences contrast.

hardJudge.note: 앞 문장(긍정적 실험 결과)과 뒤 문장(제한적 사용 + 이유)의 대조 관계를 파악해야 하며 'Even so'가 유일하게 성립. B는 콜론 뒤 원인 설명 때문에 표면적으로 그럴듯해 비교가 필요하고, C·D도 문맥상 배제 가능. 한·영 해설 모두 정답 및 오답 근거가 일치하고 정확함. 자가치유 콘크리트(네덜란드, 박테리아 포자·젖산칼슘, 0.8mm 균열) 사실관계도 알려진 내용과 부합.

advisory.note: 정답 A(Even so)는 옳음: 긍정적인 실험 결과 뒤에 제한적 사용이라는 반대 방향의 사실이 이어짐. 다만 대조 신호가 너무 뚜렷함(promising results → 'only limited use'). C(For example)와 D(Similarly)는 대조 관계와 바로 충돌해 비교하지 않아도 배제됨. B(As a result)도 콜론 뒤 이유가 명시돼 있어 쉽게 걸러짐. 오답 중 최소 2개가 부분적 근거를 가져야 한다는 medium 기준을 충족하지 못함. 비슷한 대조형 오답(However/Nevertheless 대비 Instead, In contrast 등)이 없어 두 단계 판단이 필요 없음.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Engineers in the Netherlands built the Maeslantkering, a storm-surge barrier, to protect the port of Rotterdam.
- The barrier consists of two curved steel gates, each about as long as the Eiffel Tower is tall.
- The gates normally rest in dry docks on the riverbanks, leaving the shipping channel fully open.
- When a surge of at least 3 meters is forecast, the gates swing into the channel, fill with water, and sink to close it.
- The Thames Barrier in London, by contrast, uses rotating gates mounted on piers that stand permanently in the river.

The student wants to explain how the Maeslantkering's design differs from that of the Thames Barrier. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Engineers in the Netherlands built the Maeslantkering, a storm-surge barrier, to protect the port of Rotterdam.
- The barrier consists of two curved steel gates, each about as long as the Eiffel Tower is tall.
- The gates normally rest in dry docks on the riverbanks, leaving the shipping channel fully open.
- When a surge of at least 3 meters is forecast, the gates swing into the channel, fill with water, and sink to close it.
- The Thames Barrier in London, by contrast, uses rotating gates mounted on piers that stand permanently in the river.
problem.question: The student wants to explain how the Maeslantkering's design differs from that of the Thames Barrier. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: The Maeslantkering, which protects the port of Rotterdam, has two curved steel gates, each about as long as the Eiffel Tower is tall.
When a surge of at least 3 meters is forecast, the Maeslantkering's gates swing into the channel, fill with water, and sink to close it.
Unlike the Thames Barrier, whose rotating gates are mounted on piers standing permanently in the river, the Maeslantkering keeps its gates in dry docks on the riverbanks until a surge threatens.
Both the Maeslantkering in the Netherlands and the Thames Barrier in London are storm-surge barriers that use movable gates to protect cities from flooding.
problem.explanation: 목표는 두 방벽의 설계 '차이'를 설명하는 것이므로, 마스란트케링의 게이트 보관 방식(강둑의 건식 도크)과 템스 방벽의 게이트 위치(강 속에 상시 서 있는 교각)를 대조해야 한다. C는 이 두 정보를 'Unlike'로 연결해 차이를 분명히 보여 준다. A와 B는 마스란트케링의 크기나 작동 방식을 정확히 설명하지만 템스 방벽을 언급하지 않아 비교가 이루어지지 않는다. D는 두 방벽을 모두 언급하지만 공통점을 강조할 뿐 차이를 설명하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to explain a difference in design, so the sentence has to contrast the two barriers. C does that: the Thames Barrier's gates sit on piers that stay in the river all the time, while the Maeslantkering's gates are kept in dry docks on the banks. A and B accurately describe the Maeslantkering's size and how it operates, but neither one mentions the Thames Barrier, so there's no comparison. D names both barriers, but it points out what they have in common instead of how they differ.

hardJudge.note: C가 노트 3·5를 'Unlike'로 결합해 설계 차이를 정확히 대조함. A·B는 정확하지만 비교 부재, D는 두 방벽을 언급하나 공통점만 서술 — 오답 설계 적절. 사실관계(게이트 길이 비유, 3m 기준, 템스 방벽 교각식 회전 게이트) 문제 없음. 한·영 해설 결론 및 선택지 참조 일치.

advisory.note: 사실 확인: 마스란트케링 게이트 길이는 약 210~240m로 에펠탑 높이(약 300m, 안테나 포함 330m)와 '거의 같다'는 흔한 비유이며, 3m 기준 폐쇄와 템스 방벽의 교각식 회전 게이트도 정확함. D는 두 방벽을 다 언급해 그럴듯한 오답이고, A·B는 정확한 정보만 담고 있어 노트 기반 오답으로 적절함. 다만 'Unlike'라는 단서가 너무 분명해 보통 난이도에서는 쉬운 편에 가까움.

problem.passage:
When the city of Manchester opened its first public lending libraries in the 1850s, reformers predicted that factory workers would use them mainly for self-improvement, borrowing technical manuals and works of moral instruction. Borrowing records from the libraries' first decade tell a different story: novels and travel narratives made up the large majority of loans to working-class patrons. ______ historians who study the period now argue that the libraries mattered less as tools of vocational training than as some of the first spaces where laborers could pursue reading purely for pleasure.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: When the city of Manchester opened its first public lending libraries in the 1850s, reformers predicted that factory workers would use them mainly for self-improvement, borrowing technical manuals and works of moral instruction. Borrowing records from the libraries' first decade tell a different story: novels and travel narratives made up the large majority of loans to working-class patrons. ______ historians who study the period now argue that the libraries mattered less as tools of vocational training than as some of the first spaces where laborers could pursue reading purely for pleasure.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 노동자들이 주로 소설과 여행기를 빌렸다는 대출 기록을 제시하고, 빈칸 뒤 문장은 이 기록을 근거로 도서관이 즐거움을 위한 독서 공간이었다는 역사가들의 결론을 내린다. 따라서 결과·결론을 나타내는 B가 정답이다. A는 개혁가들의 예측과 실제 기록이 대조된다는 점 때문에 그럴듯해 보이지만, 그 대조는 이미 앞 문장 안에서 표현되었다. 빈칸 문장은 바로 앞의 기록과 반대되는 내용이 아니라 그 기록과 맞아떨어진다. C는 빈칸 문장이 앞 문장의 구체적 사례가 아니라 앞 내용을 일반화한 해석이므로 틀리다. D는 앞 문장과 비슷한 별개의 사실을 덧붙이는 것이 아니라 앞 내용에서 결론을 끌어내는 문장이므로 맞지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The previous sentence gives borrowing records showing that working-class patrons mostly borrowed novels and travel narratives. The blank sentence then states historians' conclusion, based on that evidence, that the libraries were spaces for reading for pleasure. That is a result or conclusion, so B is correct. A is tempting because the reformers' prediction does contrast with the records, but that contrast is already expressed inside the previous sentence. The blank sentence doesn't go against the records just before it; it agrees with them. C is wrong because the final sentence is not a specific example of the records but a broader interpretation drawn from them. D is wrong because the sentence doesn't add a separate, similar fact; it draws a conclusion from what came before.

hardJudge.note: 빈칸 뒤 문장은 앞의 대출 기록을 근거로 한 역사가들의 결론이므로 '그에 따라'를 뜻하는 Accordingly(B)가 정답임을 직접 확인함. 개혁가 예측 vs 실제 기록의 대조가 앞 문장 내부에서 이미 완결되므로 A(Nevertheless)는 매력적이지만 틀린 오답으로 잘 설계됨. C·D도 각각 예시/병렬 관계가 아니어서 배제 가능. 한·영 해설 모두 동일 결론·글자 참조로 일관되며 영어 자연스러움. 맨체스터 공공도서관 1852년 개관 및 소설 대출 우세는 역사적 사실과 부합. 두 단계 판단(대조 위치 파악 + 인과 관계 확인)이 필요한 표준 medium 난이도에 적합.

advisory.note: Nevertheless는 대조 구조(개혁가 예측 vs 실제 기록)를 훑어 읽으면 매력적인 오답이 되고, 이를 배제하려면 빈칸이 바로 앞 문장과 맺는 관계를 확인하는 두 단계 판단이 필요하다. 사실관계도 대체로 타당하다(맨체스터 무료도서관 1852년 개관).

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Elspeth Varrow is a contemporary British novelist who writes in a style modeled on nineteenth-century fiction.
- Her 2019 novel The Lamplighter's Ledger is narrated by an intrusive narrator who directly addresses "dear reader," a device common in Victorian novels.
- The novel was first released in twelve monthly installments through a literary app, echoing the serial publication of works by Charles Dickens.
- Unlike most Victorian novels, The Lamplighter's Ledger includes text messages exchanged between characters.
- Critics praised the novel's long, ornate sentences and its large cast of minor characters.

The student wants to emphasize how Varrow's novel adapts a nineteenth-century publishing practice to modern technology. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Elspeth Varrow is a contemporary British novelist who writes in a style modeled on nineteenth-century fiction.
- Her 2019 novel The Lamplighter's Ledger is narrated by an intrusive narrator who directly addresses "dear reader," a device common in Victorian novels.
- The novel was first released in twelve monthly installments through a literary app, echoing the serial publication of works by Charles Dickens.
- Unlike most Victorian novels, The Lamplighter's Ledger includes text messages exchanged between characters.
- Critics praised the novel's long, ornate sentences and its large cast of minor characters.
problem.question: The student wants to emphasize how Varrow's novel adapts a nineteenth-century publishing practice to modern technology. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Like Dickens's novels, Varrow's The Lamplighter's Ledger appeared in serial form, though its twelve monthly installments were delivered through a literary app.
Varrow's The Lamplighter's Ledger blends old and new, pairing a Victorian-style narrator who addresses "dear reader" with text messages exchanged between characters.
The Lamplighter's Ledger (2019) was praised by critics for features typical of nineteenth-century fiction, such as long, ornate sentences and a large cast of minor characters.
Contemporary novelist Elspeth Varrow models her style on nineteenth-century fiction, as seen in the intrusive narrator of The Lamplighter's Ledger.
problem.explanation: 목표는 19세기의 '출판 관행'을 현대 기술에 맞게 바꾼 점을 강조하는 것이다. A는 디킨스식 연재 출판(관행)과 문학 앱(현대 기술)을 연결하여 두 요소를 모두 충족한다. B는 옛것과 새것의 결합을 보여 주지만 출판 관행이 아니라 서술 기법과 문자 메시지라는 내용 요소에 관한 것이다. C는 문체와 등장인물에 대한 비평만 다루어 출판이나 기술이 없다. D는 19세기풍 서술자만 언급하여 현대 기술로의 적응을 보여 주지 못한다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to highlight how a nineteenth-century publishing practice was adapted to modern technology. A does this by linking Dickens-style serial publication (the practice) with delivery through a literary app (the modern technology). B also mixes old and new, but it's about narrative devices and text messages inside the story, not about how the book was published. C covers only the critics' praise for style and characters, so it says nothing about publishing or technology. D mentions only the Victorian-style narrator and shows no adaptation to modern technology.

hardJudge.note: 정답 A는 '출판 관행(연재)'과 '현대 기술(문학 앱)' 두 조건을 모두 충족하는 유일한 선택지. B는 옛것+새것 결합이라는 부분적 근거를 가진 강력한 오답이며, C·D는 19세기 요소만 다루어 말은 되지만 기술 적응이 없음. 가상의 작가·작품으로 저작권 문제 없음. 한·영 해설 결론과 글자 참조 일치, 영어 자연스러움. 목표 '출판 관행'이라는 키워드를 정독해야 B를 배제할 수 있어 medium 적합.

advisory.note: B는 옛것과 새것을 섞는 강한 오답이라 '출판 관행'인지 '내용 요소'인지 구분해야 배제됨. C와 D는 19세기 요소만 있어 비교적 쉽게 배제되지만 그럴듯함. 중간 난이도에 적합. 작가·작품은 가상으로 보임.

problem.passage:
Ecologists long assumed that the bright orange coloration of the cinnabar moth caterpillar served mainly to warn birds that the insect is toxic, since the caterpillars store bitter alkaloids from the ragwort plants they eat. When biologist Tamsin Hale offered the caterpillars to captive starlings, many birds did reject them after a single taste. ______ a substantial number of starlings that had never encountered the caterpillars avoided them on sight, even when the caterpillars had been rinsed of most of their alkaloids, suggesting that the color itself, rather than learned distaste alone, can deter some predators.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.stimulus: Ecologists long assumed that the bright orange coloration of the cinnabar moth caterpillar served mainly to warn birds that the insect is toxic, since the caterpillars store bitter alkaloids from the ragwort plants they eat. When biologist Tamsin Hale offered the caterpillars to captive starlings, many birds did reject them after a single taste. ______ a substantial number of starlings that had never encountered the caterpillars avoided them on sight, even when the caterpillars had been rinsed of most of their alkaloids, suggesting that the color itself, rather than learned distaste alone, can deter some predators.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
problem.explanation: 앞 문장은 많은 새가 맛을 본 뒤 애벌레를 거부했다는, 기존 가정(학습된 경고 기능)을 뒷받침하는 결과를 인정한다. 뒤 문장은 그럼에도 경험 없는 새가 맛을 보지 않고도 색만 보고 피했다는, 그 설명만으로는 부족함을 보여 주는 결과를 제시하므로 양보 후 반전의 D(Even so)가 적절하다. A는 맛을 보고 거부한 것이 처음 보는 새들의 회피를 일으켰다는 인과 관계를 만들지만, 두 집단은 서로 다르므로 성립하지 않는다. B는 앞 내용을 부정하고 대체하는 의미이지만, 맛을 보고 거부한 결과는 여전히 사실로 유지된다. C는 같은 내용을 다시 말할 때 쓰지만, 뒤 문장은 새로운, 대비되는 발견을 담고 있다.
